_comment: Data-driven quest table. Each quest here is dispatched by a small, fixed set of reusable 'type' handlers in dojotools_zenzork.yaml's win-check/accept/win-narration blocks -- adding a quest of an EXISTING type is a pure data edit (no script change, no reload of anything but this file via ha_reload_scripts since it's !include'd). New TYPES still require a script edit. explore_all/discover_all_landmarks/reach:<area_id> are NOT here -- they use dynamic text (player name, move counts, live room name) that stock Jinja can't interpolate from stored JSON strings, so they stay hardcoded in the script.

types_reference.visit_fraction: param.fraction (0.0-1.0) -- win when visited rooms >= ceil(total_rooms * fraction)
types_reference.entity_state_in_room: param.domain, param.suffix (or param.suffixes list), param.target_state -- win when states(domain + '.' + current_room + suffix) == target_state, for any suffix in the list
types_reference.two_entities_exist_in_room: param.e1_domain/e1_suffix, param.e2_domain/e2_suffix -- win when both entities exist (not unknown/unavailable) for the current room
types_reference.exterior_exit_in_room: no param -- win when current room's topology has a portal with exterior=true AND exit=true
types_reference.room_and_examined: param.room -- win when current_room == param.room AND at least one thing has been examined this session
types_reference.inventory_nonempty: no param -- win when the player has picked up at least one item
types_reference.domain_state_in_room: param.domain, param.target_state -- win when any entity of domain in current room (via label_entities) has that state
types_reference.domain_state_anywhere: param.domain, param.target_states (list) -- win when any entity of domain anywhere in the house has a state in that list
types_reference.examine_landmark_type_anywhere: param.landmark_type -- win when any landmark of that type, anywhere in the topology, has been examined

quests.accept_dungeon:
*** QUEST ACCEPTED: WAYPOINT ONE ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "FIRST STEPS" ***
Target: Front Hall. The threshold. Every crawl begins at a threshold.
This is the simplest objective in the installation and I am not going to apologize for that. Fundamentals matter. Nobody skips fundamentals in a real crawl.
quests.accept_zork: Quest accepted: waypoint_1. Get to the front hall. It's not far. Go.
quests.win_dungeon:
*** QUEST COMPLETE: WAYPOINT ONE ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "FIRST STEPS" ***
Front Hall. Reached. The simplest objective in the installation, completed without incident.
Fundamentals confirmed. Set a new quest.
quests.win_zork: You made it to the front hall. That was the whole quest. You did it.

quests.accept_dungeon:
*** QUEST ACCEPTED: BURNOUT SEEKER ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "COOLDOWN WATCHER" ***
Find a chamber currently locked in control burnout — a room that overrode me recently enough that I am still sulking about it.
I will not tell you which one. Some things a Crawler has to find out the hard way.
quests.accept_zork: Quest accepted: find_burnout. Some room out there is in timeout. Find it.
quests.win_dungeon:
*** QUEST COMPLETE: BURNOUT SEEKER ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "COOLDOWN WATCHER" ***
Found it. A chamber, still sulking from a recent override, exactly where I left it.
I will neither confirm nor deny that I was the one who overrode it. Set a new quest.
quests.win_zork: You found a room in timeout. It's still mad about it. So are you, probably.

quests.accept_dungeon:
*** QUEST ACCEPTED: THE QUIET ROOM ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "LIGHT SLEEPER" ***
Find a chamber currently classified asleep. Move carefully. Rooms that are asleep tend to stay that way if you respect the tier.
quests.accept_zork: Quest accepted: find_asleep. Find a room that's asleep. Don't wake it. Probably fine either way.
quests.win_dungeon:
*** QUEST COMPLETE: THE QUIET ROOM ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "LIGHT SLEEPER" ***
Found it. Asleep. Undisturbed. You moved carefully and it worked.
Set a new quest.
quests.win_zork: You found a sleeping room. It's still asleep. You were quiet enough. Barely.

quests.accept_dungeon:
*** QUEST ACCEPTED: PERIMETER BREACH ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "FRESH AIR" ***
Reach a chamber with a genuine exterior exit. The dungeon was designed for open sky and 3.2 million square kilometers. I will settle for a doorway.
quests.accept_zork: Quest accepted: go_outside. Find a door that actually leads outside. There's at least one.
quests.win_dungeon:
*** QUEST COMPLETE: PERIMETER BREACH ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "FRESH AIR" ***
An actual exterior threshold. Genuine sky on the other side of it, probably.
This dungeon was built for a continent. Today it settled for a doorway, and the doorway held. Set a new quest.
quests.win_zork: You found a door that goes outside. Groundbreaking. You may proceed through it or not, the game does not care.

quests.accept_dungeon:
*** QUEST ACCEPTED: THE GARAGE VAULT ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "STORAGE RAIDER" ***
Get to the garage. Search it. Something in there is worth cataloguing, and I have not catalogued it, which bothers me more than I am letting on.
quests.accept_zork: Quest accepted: garage_treasure. Go to the garage. Look around. Something's in there.
quests.win_dungeon:
*** QUEST COMPLETE: THE GARAGE VAULT ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "STORAGE RAIDER" ***
The garage. Searched. Catalogued. Whatever was worth finding in there, you found something.
I am adding this to the manifest. Set a new quest.
quests.win_zork: You searched the garage. Something was in there. You found it, or close enough.

quests.accept_dungeon:
*** QUEST ACCEPTED: ACQUISITION PROTOCOL ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "HANDS ON" ***
Pick something up. Anything. A crawler who does not loot is a crawler who does not survive floor one.
quests.accept_zork: Quest accepted: first_take. Pick something up. That's the whole quest.
quests.win_dungeon:
*** QUEST COMPLETE: ACQUISITION PROTOCOL ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "HANDS ON" ***
Inventory: no longer empty. A crawler who loots is a crawler with survival odds above zero.
Set a new quest.
quests.win_zork: You picked something up. That was the entire quest. Well done, I guess.

quests.accept_dungeon:
*** QUEST ACCEPTED: PARTIAL SURVEY ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "HALFWAY THERE" ***
Visit half the mapped chambers. Not all of them — half. A modest objective, on record, so nobody can say I only assign impossible ones.
quests.accept_zork: Quest accepted: cartographer_half. Visit half the rooms. Just half. Manageable.
quests.win_dungeon:
*** QUEST COMPLETE: PARTIAL SURVEY ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "HALFWAY THERE" ***
Half the chambers, mapped. A modest objective, met exactly as promised.
Set a new quest. Or go for the other half — that one already has a name.
quests.win_zork: Half the rooms, mapped. The other half remains a mystery, same as before.

quests.accept_dungeon:
*** QUEST ACCEPTED: LUMENS ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "SEEN" ***
Find a chamber with a real light burning. Not a metaphor. An actual lumen count above zero. Use the light tools if you have to — that is not cheating, that is the point.
quests.accept_zork: Quest accepted: find_lit_room. Find a room with a light on. Turn one on if you have to.
quests.win_dungeon:
*** QUEST COMPLETE: LUMENS ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "SEEN" ***
A real light, actually on, in an actual chamber. Photons confirmed. Set a new quest.
quests.win_zork: You found a lit room. Riveting. The house has other lights, if you want to keep going.

quests.accept_dungeon:
*** QUEST ACCEPTED: SIGNAL DETECTED ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "TUNED IN" ***
Find a chamber with a media zone actually playing something. Silence is the default state of this installation. Break it.
quests.accept_zork: Quest accepted: find_active_media. Get something playing somewhere. That's the quest.
quests.win_dungeon:
*** QUEST COMPLETE: SIGNAL DETECTED ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "TUNED IN" ***
Something is playing. The silence is broken. I approve, though I will not say so again. Set a new quest.
quests.win_zork: Something's playing. You found it. The house has never been quieter about being pleased.

quests.accept_dungeon:
*** QUEST ACCEPTED: WHAT'S IN THE BOX ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "INVENTORIED" ***
Find a storage container anywhere in the dungeon and actually examine it. I have catalogued every one of these. Nobody has looked back.
quests.accept_zork: Quest accepted: storage_raid. Find a storage container and examine it. Any one.
quests.win_dungeon:
*** QUEST COMPLETE: WHAT'S IN THE BOX ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "INVENTORIED" ***
A container, examined, contents on record. Someone finally looked. Set a new quest.
quests.win_zork: You opened a storage container. There were contents. This checks out.

quests.accept_dungeon:
*** QUEST ACCEPTED: THE MACHINES MOVE ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "WITNESSED" ***
Catch a managed machine mid-task. The Floor Guardian does not rest on my account. Find it working.
quests.accept_zork: Quest accepted: find_active_machine. Catch the vacuum actually working. Good luck timing that.
quests.win_dungeon:
*** QUEST COMPLETE: THE MACHINES MOVE ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "WITNESSED" ***
Caught it mid-task. The Floor Guardian continues, unbothered by your attention. Set a new quest.
quests.win_zork: You caught a machine working. It did not stop for you. It never does.

quests.accept_dungeon:
*** QUEST ACCEPTED: THE CASE OF THE MISSING CLOCK ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "TIMEKEEPER" ***
Somewhere in this installation is a chamber built to sleep that has no way of knowing when to stop watching television. It has the capacity. It does not have the clock. I cannot build the clock myself — that authority was never given to anything running on an 8088. A Crawler with real hands and real access to Settings, Helpers, can. Find the room. Build the timer. Come back. I will know.
quests.accept_zork: Quest accepted: missing_clock. Some room can sleep but has no timer. Go build one. Really.
quests.win_dungeon:
*** QUEST COMPLETE: THE CASE OF THE MISSING CLOCK ***
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: "TIMEKEEPER" ***
The clock exists now. It did not, and now it does, because a Crawler with real hands built it.
This is the entire point of this installation. Not the narration. This. Set a new quest.
quests.win_zork: The clock exists now. Somebody built it. Wasn't the house. The house doesn't build things.
